textbookBox.concept: Long ago people measured time with the Sun, sundials and water clocks. Today we use clocks and watches. The SI unit of time is the second. 60 seconds make 1 minute and 60 minutes make 1 hour.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A pendulum is a small mass hung by a thread that swings back and forth. One complete to-and-fro swing is an oscillation. The time taken for one oscillation is its time period.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 science · Measurement of Time and Motion · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Speed tells how fast an object moves. Speed equals distance divided by time. If a car covers 120 km in 2 hours its speed is 60 km per hour.

beats.en: Speed tells how fast an object moves. Speed equals distance divided by time. If a car covers 120 km in 2 hours its speed is 60 km per hour. Speed is measured in metres per second or kilometres per hour.
beats.speakEn: Speed tells how fast an object moves. Speed equals distance divided by time. If a car covers 120 km in 2 hours its speed is 60 km per hour. Speed is measured in metres per second or kilometres per hour.

beats.en: A distance-time graph shows how far an object has gone as time passes. A straight slanted line shows steady speed. A flat line shows the object is at rest.
beats.speakEn: A distance-time graph shows how far an object has gone as time passes. A straight slanted line shows steady speed. A flat line shows the object is at rest.
